product.description: What is being launched, in the user's words.

stage.description: Where the product is now: idea, building, first users, or paying customers.
stage.x-ask: Where is the product now: idea, building, first users, or paying customers?

target_customer.description: Who the launch is for, from the user's context.

market_country.description: Country of the launch. Sets the currency, channels, and rules.
market_country.x-ask: Which country is the launch in?

document_language.description: Language for the prose. Headings stay as written in template.md.
document_language.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

research_mode.description: web when the cited pages were opened during this run. offline when they were not.
research_mode.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

monthly_budget.description: Money available each month for marketing and sales. Zero when there is none.
monthly_budget.x-ask: How much can you spend on marketing and sales each month? Say zero if nothing.

team_capacity.description: Who works on the launch and how many hours a week.
team_capacity.x-ask: Who will work on the launch, and how many hours a week?

existing_audience.description: Contacts, lists, followers, partners, or customers the user already has. One row that says none yet when there are none.
existing_audience.x-ask: What audience do you already have: contacts, an email list, followers, partners, or customers? Say none yet.

competitive_alternatives.description: What buyers would use if this product did not exist, including the status quo, each with why they use it.
competitive_alternatives.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

positioning.description: Competitive alternatives, Unique attributes, Value, Best-fit customers, Market category, in that order.
positioning.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

value_proposition.description: One sentence a best-fit customer would repeat.
value_proposition.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

buyer_roles.description: The people in the buying decision, the part each plays, and what each cares about.
buyer_roles.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

offer.description: The launch offer and price hypotheses, each with the basis.
offer.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

messaging.description: The message for each buyer role, with the proof behind it.
messaging.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

channels.description: Candidate channels, each with a page opened where one exists, why it fits, and whether to test it now, later, or skip it.
channels.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

channel_tests.description: One test per test now channel: the test, its cost, a time box, and the success threshold set before it starts.
channel_tests.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

test_budget.description: Cost of each channel test. x matches channel_tests channel and series matches cost, in the same order.
test_budget.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

primary_metric.description: The one number the launch is judged by. Revenue when anyone pays.
primary_metric.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

weekly_target.description: The weekly growth target for the primary metric, with its basis.
weekly_target.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

launch_plan.description: Dated periods from preparation to the first review, each with the actions and the milestone that ends it.
launch_plan.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

kpis.description: Metrics that feed the primary metric, each with a target and how it is measured.
kpis.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

risks.description: What could stop the launch, and the response planned for each.
risks.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

assumptions.description: Every estimate, rate, or price chosen without evidence, with its inputs.
assumptions.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

sources.description: Pages opened for this plan. Empty only when research_mode is offline.
sources.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
